svg.text: HeartSync DOCK rev C: inside 1:1, stem + puck + rail parts 1:1, side view 1:2
Inside: seen from above with the deck lifted off, front at the bottom. Dashed = underside vents and feet.
MAIN DOCK BOARD 110 x 36 (under the cradle)
PD sink 65 W · fuse + TVS · buck rails · PD source (tablet) · pogo switch · LEDs
under the stem (cable up the stem)
FRONT · grey circles = M3 bosses · dashed circles = rubber feet
puck 9 deep, tilted back 10°, centre 137.5 up
TABLET RAIL (clip-on), drawn at 160 of 200 long: full part 200 x 18 x 20
slot 13 wide, 8 deep, leaning back 15° · 2 hooks into the base back slots (X ±60)
Tab A9 211 x 124.7 x 8 stands in landscape; cable from the right-end USB-C
SIDE VIEW 1:2 (from the right, front left; all parts projected)
Power: one 65 W USB-C adapter → device 18 W + phone 15 W + buds 5 W + tablet 15 W.
The iPhone sits landscape above the HeartSync (StandBy clock); its CG stays over the base.
